metadata.name: 16x32_pixel_weapon_swing_slash
metadata.description: 16x32 pixel weapon swing slash effect animation in Stardew Valley style. Four-frame animation sequence showing white/light blue semi-transparent arc sweep. Arc motion for sword/axe swing. Frame 1: beginning of arc, Frame 2: mid-swing, Frame 3: full extension, Frame 4: fade out. Total dimensions: 64x32 (4 frames of 16x32 each arranged horizontally). Translucent effect suitable for overlay on character attacks.
